messages:
jules: Hey — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inc/model-service/pull/412. It touches api/gateway and workers/model-service and also updates CODEOWNERS to add new path. Who's allowed to approve this? I don't want to block deploy.
henry: for code changes crossing services we usually need one owner from each affected folder + an eng-platform reviewer. CODEOWNERS edits are special — someone from eng-platform must sign off as well.
samir: fwiw the change is primarily moving files into pkg/model-v2, plus the CODEOWNERS tweak. small code changes in gateway but nothing infra-y.
alex: correct — policy is in /docs/process/reviews.md. Quick excerpt:
```
- Cross-service PRs require at least one owner per top-level folder modified.
- Changes to CODEOWNERS require an eng-platform approval in addition to affected owners.
```
jules: thanks. is eng-platform ok with an async signoff? this is blocking a canary scheduled later today.
priya: I can do the eng-platform signoff if owners approve. Ping the owners in the PR and add the label `needs-eng-platform`.
jules: added label and tagged @samir @henry for worker and gateway owners.
samir: LGTM for workers. left one nit about a var name.
henry: approved for gateway.
codeowner-bot: CODEOWNERS changed: added `/pkg/model-v2/ @ml-team` — requires maintainer review.
priya: saw the bot. I reviewed the CODEOWNERS diff — confirms @ml-team should be owner. approving now.
alex: since both owners + eng-platform approved, you can merge. remember to include changelog entry.
jules: merged and started canary. thanks everyone :tada:
samir: nice — monitor logs for increased latency on model endpoints, will watch.
priya: noted, will keep an eye on dashboards.
jules: closing thread — thanks all :rocket:
